failureMessage: D2 path utility did not return every constructed route path.
cause: The checker deduplicated exact strings before the pinned utility normalized every input with IO.Path.GetFullPath; equivalent slash/path spellings collapsed only inside the utility, and measurement lookup remained unnormalized.
recovery: Do not rerun R3. Use a fresh R4 checker cloned from the original D2 script with GetFullPath normalization before uniqueness and for measurement lookup, plus explicit PSCustomObject route rows.
